interaction.description: Asks individual students questions or invites them to contribute
Provides identifiable opportunities for student answers or contributions
Follows up on answers rather than merely asking a question
Invites students to explain their reasoning or demonstrate understanding
Maintains interaction across multiple portions of the class, not only the opening

rapport.description: Offers introductions, personal check-ins, or an equivalent rapport-building activity
Personally acknowledges a student or their contribution
Uses attentive, respectful and encouraging responses to participants

communication.description: Provides clear verbal instructions for activities
Explains concepts in understandable, meaningful steps
Provides useful, constructive corrections or feedback
Uses supportive, polite and encouraging wording during the class

structure.description: Introduces or frames the lesson at the beginning
Shows clear transitions between classroom activities
Follows a coherent sequence of lesson activities
Provides a closing summary or clear conclusion

homework.description: Explicitly assigns homework or follow-up practice
Gives actionable instructions about what students should do
Connects follow-up work to lesson objectives or content

visual.description: The tutor is visibly present in relevant sampled frames
Appropriate classroom background or branding is visible where applicable
The tutor is adequately lit in observed camera frames
Displayed teaching materials are readable and relevant
No significant tutor camera-visibility problem is evidenced across sampled frames
